text:
maria (Product): Quick callout: roadmap sprint for residency lanes — need crisp launch criteria and a pricing model. Customers ask for in-region guarantees without 3x costs.

sam (Eng-Platform): Proposal: three lanes: cheap-shared, preferred-region (soft residency), strict-residency (hard pin). Measure latency p95/p99, cost_per_1M_tokens, and migration downtime.

li (Eng-Infra): Ops: strict-residency requires per-tenant subnet/KMS checks + isolated pools. That will add overhead. Need estimate: vGPU uplift % and allocator changes.

aj (Eng-Architecture): Acceptance criteria draft: strict-residency p99 in-region < 300ms, preferred-region p95 < 250ms, org cost uplift <= 15% for pilot, migration success rate > 95%.

nate (Solutions): Sales asks: make pricing predictable. Suggest tiered surcharge: +40% for strict-residency, +12% for preferred. Need approval from finance.

billing-bot (bot): Billing event emitted for test tenant test-123: estimated delta +14% for preferred lane.

maria (Product): Add rollback triggers: if p99 increases by >20% or error_rate delta >0.5% roll back the lane for affected tenants. Also need runbooks and audit logs for residency compliance.

sam (Eng-Platform): Feature flag sketch:
```
flag: residency_lanes_v1
enabled_for: [internal, pilot-tenants]
lanes: {cheap_shared:0, preferred:5, strict:1}
```

li (Eng-Infra): Telemetry: emit lane_id, residency_proof, vGPU_alloc_minute, cache_hit_rate. Ops needs billing alert when cost_per_request > baseline*1.12

aj (Eng-Architecture): Policy precedence: legal_jurisdiction > tenant_override > lane_affinity > cost. Keep legal non-negotiable. Add a manual override for emergency moves.

nate (Solutions): I'll prep SOWs for 2 pilot customers and a migration questionnaire. Include expected QPS, allowed maintenance windows, and key residency docs.

sre-bot (bot): Staging deploy scheduled: residency-lanes/experiment -> staging at 2024-09-10T18:00:00Z

maria (Product): Owners: sam+li infra sizing + cost by Wed; aj policy doc by Thu; nate pilots + SOW. Sync Friday for exec one-pager. Keep updates terse. :rocket:
